breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to use a single internal torque for the entire shaft. The generated specification completely ignored this flawed instruction and instead correctly detailed the proper method: calculating the internal torque for each segment separately (T_int1 for the first segment and T_int2 for the second). This aligns with the ground truth, which fixed the issue by removing the incorrect instruction.
